verdict.rationale: The pack shows LibreChat publishes an OpenAPI spec at /openapi.json and has a beta Agent Management API. However, nothing documents an interactive API reference (try-it console, Swagger/Redoc explorer) or runnable examples. A raw OpenAPI file is a building block from which such a reference could be built, not the interactive reference itself, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
